# Savvy Studio

> Savvy Studio designs and builds intelligent systems, AI automation, digital products and operational software for businesses with complex problems and workflows.

## Identity & Contact
- Canonical Domain: https://savvystudio.cc/
- Contact: hello@savvystudio.cc
- Primary Positioning: Intelligent Systems & Digital Products

## Core Capabilities
- AI Automation: Workflows, agents, orchestration, automated document extraction, classification, and operational automation.
- Intelligent Systems: Autonomous decision systems, grounded retrieval, competitive intelligence, and predictive scoring models.
- Digital Products: Bespoke web applications, client portals, internal operational tools, and custom conversion interfaces.
- Operational Software: Systems built around real business processes, tracking tasks, field operations, and workflows.
- Integrations: API connectivity, database synchronizations, and event-driven pipelines.

## Selected Work & Systems
- [SavvyEdge](https://savvystudio.cc/work/savvyedge): Real-time intelligence infrastructure for iGaming, analyzing changing game conditions, RTP variations, and bonus math.
- [Blueprint](https://savvystudio.cc/work/blueprint): Product control and evidence verification system, identifying boundaries, blockers, and runtime evidence.
- [Eye](https://savvystudio.cc/work/eye): Field operations system for client visits, route planning, account histories, and operational next actions.
